p219.title: Vanished Contractor Dues Assessment (EPF Act s.8A)
p219.subtitle: EPFO Office Compliance Wing — Section 7A Inquiry & Section 8A Determination
p219.traceableNo: Untraceable / Vanished (cannot be traced at site)
p219.ruleTitle: Statutory Liability under EPF Act Section 8A
p219.ruleDescription: Where contractor dues for contract workers at a principal employer's site remain unpaid and the contractor cannot be traced, dues are assessed against the principal employer under EPF Act s.8A. The principal employer may recover the assessed amount from the contractor by deduction from amounts payable or as a debt.
p219.ruleException: Statutory Exception: A contractor with its own EPF code number who is traceable is liable itself — dues cannot be assessed against the principal employer.
p219.exceptionError: Cannot assess principal employer: A contractor with an EPF code number who is traceable is liable itself under Section 8A.
p219.orderSuccess: Order successfully passed under Section 7A read with Section 8A against principal employer.
p219.principalRecoveryNotice: Principal employer recovery: The principal employer has the statutory right to recover this amount from the contractor via bill deduction or debt recovery.
